request: 정규 클랜전 승리 보상에 1인당 1,000억 코인, 공격 30회 완료 참가 보상에 1인당 500억 코인을 추가한다.

implementation.missingConfig: Approved defaults are merged with existing saved settings without rewriting other reward amounts
implementation.roundRules: Existing snapshots and receipts retain their amounts; new round snapshots freeze both coin amounts
implementation.transaction: Coin ledger, wallet updates, existing inventory items and the settlement receipt are committed in one existing DB batch
guards: ON regular round, completed result and resolved attacks
Winner membership and participation qualification remain independent
Shared receipt prevents duplicate and concurrent payment
Wallet limits, missing/zero-row writes and every log are verified; any failure rolls back the bundle
Coin-log proof uses the existing created_at index

development.note: Before adding created_at index bounds; the final scoped gate rechecks the updated statements.

productionReadOnly.coinColumns: users.coin, coin_logs.change_amount and balance_after are BIGINT

release.reason: Regular clan-round settlement and CMS only; existing DB batch and schema are reused. Validate fixed amounts, qualification, atomicity, retries, frozen rules, pig-coin preservation and CMS integration.
